caption: The drawing consists of six rectangular sections arranged in a 2x3 grid, each bordered by brown lines resembling wooden frames. Each section contains a distinct pattern dominated by botanical motifs such as leaves and flowers. The top left section features swirling floral shapes in shades of blue, ivory, light green, and a small amount of red. The top center section displays overlapping large leaves and flower petals in cream, light yellow, green, and red hues. The top right section shows three prominent leaves in varied shades of green with red accents and veins. The bottom left section contains layered leaves in olive green and brown, with a cluster of rose and burgundy-colored elements. The bottom center section holds pale blue, cream, beige, and pink shaded petals over a dark blue background. The bottom right section features jagged leaves in light green and teal with pink accents on a black background. All sections appear textured, as if illustrated to represent embroidery or woven textile patterns. The background of the full drawing is a beige or off-white color, and the overall composition is symmetrical, with equal-sized framed sections.
title: Afghan Throw
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
